summary: Cycurion, Inc. filed an 8-K to report its entry into an Asset Purchase Agreement to acquire substantially all assets of Kustom Entertainment's video-solutions business. Consideration includes $1.25M cash at closing, a $4.25M secured promissory note bearing 7% interest maturing in three years, up to $1M contingent earnout, and warrants for 2M shares at $2.80 per share. The filing lists no board recommendation or advisor. The structure uses secured debt and equity-linked instruments, with closing subject to customary conditions. Watch for regulatory clearance and integration risk.
